instruction: A hand-modeled plasticine sloth hanging from a short stubby branch by two long curved arms with three fat clay claws each. The shaggy coat is built from pressed strips of mottled grey-brown clay with visible thumbprints and tool grooves, and a lighter tan mask surrounds two sleepy dark eyes with a permanent grin below. Slight fingerprint dimples and a soft matte waxy sheen sell the stop-motion feel.
